ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a visible pixel intensity ratio of approximately 60% high-intensity (white/light gray) to 40% low-intensity (black/dark gray) across the ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive mottling consisting of high-density circular low-intensity blobs (5-20 pixels in diameter) across both lobes, with larger contiguous dark regions localized at the median notch and the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a bounding-box depth occupying roughly 15% of the visible vertical fluke plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 5 to 25 pixels from the localized mean curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave sweep trajectory extending from the median notch to the outer tips, culminating in sharp, posteriorly-tapered distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed constellations of circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white centers with dark rings and dark centers with white rings) distributed globally across both fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, low-intensity vertical and diagonal linear streaks visible on the left lobe and lower-central region of the right lobe, intersecting the circular mottling pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface scarring composed of hundreds of circular rosettes and several parallel linear rake marks across the entire visible ventral area.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of well-defined barnacle-associated circular rosettes covering over 70% of the visible pixel area of the fluke.
